payload.title: [Fig. 10] Consistency of the PAGES 2k ensemble
payload.description: This workflow analyzes the consistency of the PAGES 2k (2019) ensemble of GMST reconstructions by applying inter and intra-ensemble distance metrics. It reproduces Figure 10 from the associated paper, using various statistical and visualization techniques to compare different reconstruction methods, including offline DA and LMRv2.1.
